findings.description: The `initial` attribute is replaced by `multiplier`, so existing code that reads `wait.initial` now raises AttributeError.
findings.rationale: Trigger: code or subclasses that access `wait_exponential_jitter(...).initial`. Mechanism: `self.initial` is no longer set, only `self.multiplier`. Impact: AttributeError at runtime. Because `initial` is only deprecated, this backward-compat break is probably unintended, but the attribute was likely rarely used publicly.
